description: This course explores the intersections of science and culture in Japan. Students gain field research experience while examining the unique ecosystems of the Kii Peninsula, a UNESCO World Heritage Site home to numerous endemic species of flora and fauna, including waterfall-climbing fish and giant salamander. The course also introduces cultural perspectives and ethical issues related to the life sciences. Offered periodically during January term. Prerequisite: BIO 150 - Foundations in Biodiversity.
name: Science and Culture in Japan
notes: This is a study abroad course. You will find this course listed in Studio Abroad
title: Exploring Science and Culture in Japan: Kii Peninsula
